diagram.title: Factorial of 3 on the call stack
diagram.caption: For $n>1$, $F(n)=nF(n-1)$. The base case $F(1)=1$ starts the returns in the reverse order of the calls.

layers.label: 1. Push the frame for factorial of 3
2. Push the frame for factorial of 2
3. Push the base case for factorial of 1
4. Pop the frame for 1 and return 1
5. Pop the frame for 2 and return 2
6. Pop the frame for 3 and return 6
layers.detail: Compute $F(3)=3\times 2=6$ and return to the caller.
